transcript.content: Hello, I'm Dr. Smith. It's nice to meet you; could you tell me what brings you in to see me today?

Well... I came in because my family and friends made me. They keep showing me these bank papers, saying it proves nothing was taken from me. But... I mean, for over a year now, I've known they're hiding my money. They just use things to cover it up—like paying bills, or these fundraisers, and planning trips. It's all a cover. So I have to keep confronting them. I'm not gonna stop until they finally tell the truth.
Aside from these beliefs about your money, have you been hearing any voices or seeing things that other people around you do not seem to notice?
No, nothing like that. I don't hear voices, and I don't see things that aren't there. I mean... I'm not crazy. I just see what they're actually doing with my money, plain as day. That's all it is.
